title: Players wanted a quicker way into my AI RPG, so I made a character selection screen
author: tschilpi
selftext:
After sharing my AI Dungeon Master game here, I got feedback that some players wanted to jump into an adventure without spending too long on character setup.

I’ve been working on this screen to give them a few characters with distinct personalities and a quicker place to start. I use Claude Code and Codex while building the game; the design challenge here was giving each character enough personality to make the choice interesting without dumping a full character sheet on the player.

Does each character come across at a glance? Is it clear what kind of adventurer you’re choosing, or is anything in the UI confusing?

The game is playable here if you want to try the opening: [https://www.llmsaga.com/](https://www.llmsaga.com/)
